properties.name: Refreshing an untagged cut, release_includes_all keeps every already-included artifact's earlier frozen checksum, so the manifest names files the release will not ship
properties.statement: MET 2026-10-17 refreshing the v0.86.0 cut (rel:v0860, not yet tagged) after two commits landed on it (Tantivy 0.27; the Anchor removal). 25 registered files changed after the cut had frozen its manifest, and one included test file was deleted. release_includes_all {apply:false} reported added 1, already_present 801: each changed artifact kept the checksum frozen before the change (art:deprecation 1e71e5d6… against the file's 482dd7e1…), and the deleted file stayed included. That is right for a TAGGED release (what shipped must not move) and wrong for a cut still being assembled. WORKAROUND: delete_edge INCLUDES rel:v0860 -> each changed artifact (25 calls, plus the deleted file's), then release_includes_all {apply:true, exclude:[the deleted file's artifact]}: added 25 at the current checksums, 801 entries. Expected: a way to re-freeze an untagged release's entries (say `refreeze: true`, refused once the release is deployed or tagged), or the cut procedure saying the manifest is frozen last, after every commit. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
